Add the overlay to your streaming app

OBS Studio

  1. Copy the overlay URL above.
  2. In Sources, select + and choose Browser.
  3. Paste the URL into the URL field.
  4. Set the width and height to the size shown under the URL.
  5. Leave Custom CSS empty or keep its default. The page is already transparent.

Streamlabs Desktop

  1. Select Copy overlay URL.
  2. In Sources, select + and choose Browser Source.
  3. Paste the URL and set the width and height shown under the URL.
  4. Save, then drag the source to where you want it in the scene.

The overlay only reads the public Squeekchain status API. No accounts, keys, wallets or tracking. Resting is celebrated as much as running.
